**Ledgerly** is a self-hosted personal finance app: bills and due dates, which account pays them, projected running balances, and loans with amortization tables. Each user's data is private.
This repository publishes the Production release of Ledgerly for Unraid. For help or bug reports, open an issue at https://github.com/007darkmatter5/ledgerly/issues.
